narrow-spectrum-bait.name: Narrow-Spectrum Bait
narrow-spectrum-bait.description:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

necramech-summon.name: Necramech Summon
necramech-summon.description: Summon a Necramech to the battlefield.

nexifera-echo-lure.name: Nexifera Echo-Lure
nexifera-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Nexifera with life-like animal calls.

nexifera-pheromone-gland.name: Nexifera Pheromone Gland
nexifera-pheromone-gland.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Nexifera.

nightfall-apothic.name: Nightfall Apothic
nightfall-apothic.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.

norg-bait.name: Norg Bait
norg-bait.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Norg, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon lake hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

nosam-cutter.name: Nosam Cutter
nosam-cutter.description:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
